props.title: Key judgments — shadow-fleet AIS gaps
props.body:
## Highest-value imagery tasking windows

1. **AGNI** 2025-06-25 to 2025-11-20 — longest silence, 148 days.
2. **CLYDE NOBLE** 2025-05-19 to 2025-09-08 — 111.8-day silence plus MMSI change.
3. **WONDER VEGA** 2025-07-17 to 2025-09-03 — 47.7-day silence plus MMSI change.
4. **TREND** 2025-11-02 to 2025-12-08 — 35.1-day silence, tight geographic boundary.

---

### Sensor recommendation

- **SAR first** for every window: cloud and night independent.
- **High-resolution optical** when daylight and cloud allow: deck activity, rendezvous, possible STS indicators.
- For MMSI-change gaps, task both the **late-gap** and **first-reappearance** windows to see whether the same hull returns under a new identity.

props.title: Caveats
props.body:
These are AIS transmission gaps from records returned through the Denodo-governed AIS view.

They indicate **absence of returned observations**, not proof of deliberate AIS disablement.

Satellite imagery is the independent corroboration step.
